conclusion: Encoding several player crops together improved the five-minute reconnection check from 18 correct / 2 wrong to 21 correct / 0 wrong, while retaining all 90 correct short-clip connections. Two additional short-clip joins remain unverified.
selection_note: The joint-image 2B configuration was one of six challengers fixed before regression scoring and tied the best development objective. The preset tie-break chose averaged 2B embeddings as the primary method. Both are shown, alongside the primary language-model choice; the highlighted challenger is not a new independently validated winner.
embedding_conclusion: The 2B joint-image challenger added three correct five-minute connections and removed both reviewed wrong joins without losing an existing correct pair. It retained the same 90 correct short-clip pairs, with four unverified joins instead of two. Averaging separate image vectors, the primary development choice, removed the stress-test wrong joins but lost one correct short-clip connection. The larger 8B model did not beat this result: its mean-image veto kept the short-clip baseline and reached 19 correct / 1 wrong in the five-minute clip; its joint-image veto tied the baseline.
conservative_conclusion: The revised 8B prompt reduced direct same/different order reversals but produced more uncertainty. The unchanged baseline won its development tie. Its hybrid policy recovered 21 of 26 five-minute connections with one wrong join, while losing two correct connections across the short clips. It did not establish a consistent improvement.
